notes: The URLs in the brief (application/mastersdegree, degrees/master) return 404; the live pages are application/master.html and programs/master.html. UZH programme pages are marketing text only; admission rules come from the shared master page, the language page (IELTS/TOEFL for English-taught programmes, cited only where the programme or faculty page names English as the teaching language), and the Faculty of Business, Economics and Informatics admission pages (GRE/GMAT). No deadline is recorded: the UZH deadlines page and programme pages state days and months without a year. Skipped: minors (Informatics minor, Behavioral Economics, Accounting and Corporate Finance, Investment Management, Sustainable Finance, Business Analytics etc.), Neural Systems and Computation and Neuroinformatics (not read), the remaining 100+ programmes (humanities, law, medicine, science) and the Business Administration major. Per-programme PDF fact sheets were not read. No China-specific page exists.
